context: A koban late afternoon. Mei has walked in tearful but composed — her wallet was stolen on the train. Takeda gets her seated.
purpose: small theft report — composed citizen, careful officer

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: すみません…財布、なくしました。
lines.en: Excuse me… I've lost my wallet.
lines.style: Composed but slightly tear-edged voice — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こちらへどうぞ。座って、まず。
lines.style: A small kind direction. Calm professional.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 電車の中で、たぶん。本当にすみません。
lines.en: On the train — probably. Truly, I'm sorry.
lines.style: A reflexive Japanese apology. Voice catches.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 謝らないでください。何時頃、どこの線でしたか。
lines.en: Please don't apologise. About what time, which line?
lines.style: Plain professional questions, calm tone — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Around one o'clock, on the Yamanote line.
lines.style: A small careful answer. Voice steadying.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本当に、心配ですよね。今、確認します。
lines.en: Truly — it's worrying. I'll check now.
lines.style: A small validation. Pen in motion in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お時間取らせて、すみません。
lines.en: Sorry to take up your time.
lines.style: A small bow inside the voice. Polite.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そのために、ここにいますから。
lines.en: That's exactly what I'm here for.
lines.style: A small warm professional line. Real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本当に。
lines.style: A real small catch. Eyes wet.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大丈夫。一緒に、ちゃんとやりましょう。
lines.en: It's alright. We'll handle this together, properly.
lines.style: A small grounded reassurance — voice carries the moment fully.
